canonical_summary: Market gardeners in Paris face difficulties and require practice to perfect their craft; they water more than other gardeners using large apple watering cans for light and copious waterings with focus on retaining tenderness and developing healthy vegetables. Jardiniers-maraîchers J. G. MOREAU et I. J. DAVERNE won the grand gold medal of 1,000 francs from the Royal and Central Agricultural Society in 1844.
